scope: Native Chrome sidepanel Notes acceptance for EXT-D-0061/0062/0063/0067/0068 using real admin sign-in and the approved organization selected through the UI. One newly created owned note was used for the autosave and delete flow.

passed: Real admin UI sign-in and approved organization selection succeeded.
D61 list transport failure remained visibly failed, did not look empty, and recovered through the real retry.
D62 create transport failure exposed retry while preserving create access, then recovered through a real create.
D63 latest autosave draft was saved and restored after reload and reopening.
D67 detail transport failure and a successful missing-row response remained terminal; a real detail retry restored the editor.
D68 failed delete preserved the editor and draft; a zero-affected-row response also preserved them and required confirmation for retry.
Confirmed deletion produced a live 2xx response correlated to the owned note request, the owned note was absent after reload, and no new autosave dispatched after deletion.
unverified: Original feature and mode breadth outside these five named cases.

evidence: The owned delete label came from the Fetch interception networkId mapped to the corresponding Network requestId; an interception ID alone was not accepted.
The correlated owned delete returned HTTP 2xx.
After releasing the held autosave, the autosave dispatch count did not increase; a live reload then showed the owned note absent.
The unpacked build identity and tree hash matched before and after the browser run.
quality.limitation: The run verifies this real admin organization and one newly created note; it does not establish broader feature or mode coverage.

delete_evidence.request_scope: workbench.notes, owned note id only; identifier omitted
